item.text: I’m implementing telemetry as a small self-contained reporter with an HTTP event client and durable state. The repository has no analytics SDK or endpoint/key configuration, so the implementation will post the anonymous event to Flipt’s telemetry endpoint and keep network/state errors isolated from startup. I’ll also add the requested `Flipt` JSON handler in `internal/info`.
